title: bank
summary: MSUI implements Benilla's six-opcode bank wire. Inventory right-click deposits with CMSG_AUTOBANK_ITEM and the exact clicked source position; bank-slot right-click withdraws with CMSG_AUTOSTORE_BANK_ITEM and the exact bank source position. Both bodies are two bytes and leave destination selection to the server.

openItems.text: CMSG_AUTOBANK_ITEM: absent (deposit uses CMSG_SWAP_ITEM with a client-picked bank slot instead of letting the server choose the first free slot)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: added opcode 0x0283, exact [sourceBag, sourceSlot] builder/sender, and production inventory routing that passes the clicked wire position without scanning for a bank destination.

openItems.text: CMSG_AUTOSTORE_BANK_ITEM: absent (withdraw likewise diverges from the reference right-click auto-move wire)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: added opcode 0x0282, exact [sourceBag, sourceSlot] builder/sender, and bank right-click routing that names only the clicked source slot without scanning for an inventory destination.
